A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CARF has been a success, with the SoE 2011 report receiving wide support and being used to drive policy and decision making.
the CARF has enabled the 2011 SoE to be the most independent, integrated, transparent, evidence based, and comprehensive SoE to date.
the 2011 national SoE report was the first in Australia's history that was independent and integrated, and based on a robust assessment of the state of the environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CARF is a flexible, robust and effective framework for assessing the environment at a national scale in data poor regions.
a national SoE report can be produced in a way that is independent of government, and can be produced at a cost that is commensurate with the value of such an independent, integrated assessment.
a CARF approach is a practical and effective way to address the challenge of integrating biophysical and human dimensions of the environment in national assessments.
